name: Takara Sushi Okdol Hot Stone Bowl Beef, Egg & White Rice (No Kimchi/Gochujang Mod)
whyItWorks: Steamed white rice, tender marinated bulgogi beef, and a cooked egg in a sizzling stone bowl provide high-calorie, dairy-free nourishment when you skip the fiery gochujang chili paste and raw bean sprouts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Beef Okdol (Hot Stone Bowl) with the red chili sauce on the side (do not use it), and ask to hold raw bean sprouts and kimchi.
watchOuts: Never mix in the spicy red gochujang chili paste—use a splash of plain soy sauce instead
